model_annotation: The graph displays the F1 score performance of three models—lattice, FLAT, and OURS—across a range of epochs, with the x-axis representing the number of epochs (labeled as "epoch (次)") and the y-axis showing the F1 score. The x-axis is linear, ranging from 0 to 18, with tick marks at intervals of 2. The y-axis is also linear, ranging from 0.55 to 0.90, with tick marks at intervals of 0.05. The red line with square markers represents the lattice model, starting at an F1 score of approximately 0.57 at epoch 2 and rising to about 0.68 at epoch 14, after which it slightly decreases to approximately 0.66 at epoch 16. The blue line with circular markers represents the FLAT model, beginning at an F1 score of approximately 0.76 at epoch 2, peaking at about 0.78 at epoch 10, and then gradually decreasing to approximately 0.72 at epoch 16. The yellow line with triangular markers represents the OURS model, starting at an F1 score of approximately 0.78 at epoch 2, peaking at about 0.77 at epoch 10, and then gradually decreasing to approximately 0.73 at epoch 16.
